note: Owner Emphasis rulings. This file is the CANONICAL layer for Emphasis decided by the owner rather than by the detector, and apply-emphasis.mjs merges it on top of audit/emphasis-audit.json.
why: emphasis-audit.json is written by audit-emphasis.mjs, a DERIVE step. A ruling written into it would be erased the next time the audit ran, with no error anywhere. Same shape as audit/themes-owner-rulings.json and audit/claims-final.json.
device: ACROSTIC — Q brackets individual letters so that they spell an acronym across the line. The brackets are the emphasis: they exist purely to make the reader see a word hidden inside a sentence, which is a presentation device rather than a claim, a question or a code to be decoded.
notEquivalent: Bracketed ABBREVIATIONS are a different device and are deliberately excluded: [D] and [F] in #3911, #4317, #4325, #4489 and #4688 stand for Democrat and Foreign. Those brackets abbreviate a word, they do not spell one. A pattern scan for '3+ single-letter brackets on one line' catches both, which is why the set was read rather than taken from the scan — #4317 in particular appears to spell 'DRRD' only because four unrelated abbreviations sit on one line.
retrieval: Archive-wide scan of all 4,966 posts for lines carrying 2 or more single-letter brackets: 25 lines, 18 distinct letter sequences, of which these 4 are acrostics. All 4 were unclassified in every section. The standalone acronym NCSWIC on the following line of #4951 was already certified Emphasis; only the bracketed line was unregistered.

rulings.reasoning: Owner ruling. The brackets mark the letters spelling NCSWIC, the acronym Q writes plainly on the next line of the same drop.
Owner ruling. Same device: bracketed initials spelling NSA.
